title: 心理的アセスメント
subtitle: Psychological Assessment
educationalGoal:
Psychological assessment is a multifaceted process of understanding the client's problems and resources and finding appropriate interventions.In this course, you will learn about the following four points.1.Psychological assessment objectives and ethics,2. Perspective and development of psychological assessment,  3.Method of psychological assessment, 4. How to write appropriate records and reports.
In this course, we will conduct some exercises.
advice: This course provides a comprehensive study of psychological assessment.Therefore, this course consists of definition of psychological assessment, related matters, behavior observation, interview, psychological examination, case presentation, etc.With regard to psychological tests, we will select several tests, conduct an exercise to take the test and analyze the results.
requiredKnowledge: Other courses related to this course are:Introduction to psychology, introduction to clinical psychology, developmental psychology, psychological exercises, etc.

activityGoals.body: Ability to explain the basics of psychological assessment.
Ability to outline each method of psychological assessment.
Ability to explain the theoretical background and how to perform the specified psychological test.
Ability to consider and explain the subject's psychological resources from the results of psychological tests
Ability to properly record behavioral observations and interview results.
Ability to take ethical considerations when dealing with psychological tests and psychological data.

achievementLevels.ideal:
Explain the purpose and methods of psychological assessment, including related concepts.
To be able to conduct psychological tests smoothly and with proper procedures, paying attention to ethical considerations.
Integrate the results of behavioral observations, assessment interviews, and psychological tests, and report the interpretation of the subject's characteristics in writing.
achievementLevels.standard:
Explain the purpose and method of psychological assessment.
Perform psychological tests with ethical considerations and describe the results.
Interpret the characteristics of the subject while integrating information from behavior observation and assessment interviews.
